summary: Implemented three related features. (1) Per-phase evidence: a shared resolveEvidenceVersion(pkgname, request) helper in lib/swamp.ts resolves the packager evidence version (request.version when built, else author-<pkgname>'s recorded version, else null), plus getStageEvidence(pkgname, stage, version) which builds the correct evidence key (bare pkgname for analysis/author, <pkgname>-<version> for checksums/build/lint/audit) and reads both the structured resource and its raw *log data. New route GET /api/requests/[pkgname]/evidence?stage=<stage> wires these together (400 {error} only for an invalid/missing stage; missing data yields nulls, never a 404). A new shared component components/package-request/phase-evidence.tsx renders one stage's evidence lazily on expand (passed Badge, author's version/license/depends/makedepends, author's rationale, build's duration+artifacts, lint/audit's checks table, plus a collapsed raw-log <pre>) and is used in two places: build-section.tsx's step checklist (mapping workflow step names analyze/author/checksums/build/lint/audit to evidence stages) and a new fixed 6-phase list in build-report-section.tsx. (2) Retry with hints: lib/swamp.ts gained recordRetry() (runs the existing '@omarchy/package-request' record-retry method) and triggerPackageBuild() now accepts an optional hints argument appended as an extra --input (backward compatible; existing approve-route argv unaffected). New route POST /api/requests/[pkgname]/retry validates approver/hints, calls recordRetry then triggerPackageBuild(updated, hints), returning {triggered:true}; any record-retry failure (not currently 'approved', or no such request) is surfaced as 409. build-section.tsx now shows a destructive Alert with a hints Textarea and 'Retry with hints' button whenever the polled run's status is 'failed', and restarts build-status polling after a successful retry via a retryTick counter. (3) Durable dossier: lib/swamp.ts gained getDurableDossier(pkgname, version), reading the pipeline's infinite-lifetime dossier-<pkgname>-<version> snapshot (written on both success and failure). The report route now resolves the version first and, if the durable dossier exists, returns it immediately as {source:'report', markdown, json:null, evidence:null} before touching the existing @omarchy/package-dossier report-get/version-walk/evidence-fallback chain (kept intact as a fallback for pre-dossier-model or ancient data). Failure dossiers are made visible for 'approved' packages by mounting BuildReportSection inside BuildSection whenever the latest run is 'failed', rather than only gating it on request.status in request-details-panel.tsx (which is unchanged). Added the shadcn 'alert' component (components/ui/alert.tsx) via the shadcn CLI for the failure Alert. Added mocked-execFile vitest coverage for: resolveEvidenceVersion (request.version vs author fallback vs null), getStageEvidence's key construction per stage (bare vs versioned, and the null-version short-circuit), getDurableDossier, recordRetry's argv and error passthrough, triggerPackageBuild's optional hints argument, plus route-level tests for evidence/retry/report (including dossier-first short-circuit and fallback-chain call counts).
notes: npm test (58 tests across 5 files), npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run build all pass. The 'lint'/'audit' packager stages are not currently surfaced as individual steps in build-status's step list (they run inside a further-nested vet-package workflow that getBuildStatus doesn't query directly) -- their evidence is still fully reachable via the fixed 6-phase list in BuildReportSection and directly via the /evidence API, just not as an expandable row in the in-progress step checklist; wiring vet-package's steps into getBuildStatus would be a separate, larger change to workflow-run introspection and was out of scope here. record-retry and the create-package workflow's `hints` input already existed in the swamp extension/workflow YAML before this work item -- only the app-side plumbing (lib/swamp.ts, the retry route, and the UI) was added. The repo's git working tree was already dirty with prior, uncommitted factory work before this session started (e.g. app/, components/package-request/, lib/swamp.ts itself were all untracked); filesChanged above lists only what this work item touched, not that pre-existing state. FIX.json in the app root is leftover from an earlier, unrelated review round and was left untouched.
